messages:
Nina: Quick heads-up 10 We're spinning up a small pricing experiment tomorrow: "compact sparkline" calculator + micro-FAQ. Goal: cleaner page, higher demo CTR and better lead quality.
Ravi: sounds good. metric targets?
Nina: primary = demo CTA clicks/pageview (baseline 3.0%). target +1.0pp. secondary = demo form submit rate and qual (company size).
Adele: copy variants? micro-FAQ tone?
Nina: Variant A = examples-first (3 short use cases + estimate). Variant B = zero-friction compact form (tokens/day + tier). FAQ becomes inline tooltips. Legal reviewed "ephemeral by default" and asked to link privacy doc.
Marco: routing: tag qs param `exp=compact_spark_v1`. If prefiller estimate >$3k/mo -> route to AE-mid, else AE-sdr. Also add event `calc_used` + label `compact_spark_v1`.
LaunchBot: preview: https://preview.redwood.dev/pricing?exp=compact_spark_v1 (build 1938).
Ravi: rollout plan?
Nina: 7 days at 12% traffic, 50/50 variants. Check day 3 for signal; if clear, shift to 25/75.
Adele: accessibility: ensure ARIA live announces estimate and tooltip focus order stable. Event `faq_tooltip_open` required.
Marco: dev ask: make toggle keyboard friendly and fire `tooltip_open` with tooltip id.
Nina: webinar tie: users estimating >$2k see a gentle CTA: "Join cost clinic" which opens a 15-min signup modal. Track `webinar_reg_from_calc`. If experiment shows lift, schedule a webinar next Thurs and use benchmark slides.
Ravi: who owns benchmarks? I can pull latency vs cost CSV and make 2 slides: chat vs batch workloads + sample monthly projections.
Adele: sales script: short snippet: "We estimated $X/mo for your workload; here are 3 levers to try." will hand to AEs.
Nina: final checklist: design ok, legal ok, dev hooks added, analytics wired. Flip 12% tomorrow 9am PT if green. I'll post results daily in this thread. :rocket:
